name: Green Line extension: Nagasandra – Madavar
scope: 3.03 km northern extension of the Green Line, part of Namma Metro Phase 2
notes: Became operational 2024-11-07, per The Metro Rail Guy and independently per Metro Rail News. Cost reporting conflicts across sources: ₹298 cr (Metro Rail News, at opening — recorded here), a separate ₹247.41 cr civil contract to Simplex Infrastructure Limited awarded ~February 2017, and a ₹1,168 cr figure including ₹152 cr land acquisition (both from unconfirmed secondary reporting, not recorded as figures). These may describe different scopes (one contract package vs. total project vs. total including land) rather than a true conflict, but this has not been resolved.
